managed.name: db-import-host
managed.description: Bring your databases over from a MySQL, MariaDB or PostgreSQL server installed on this machine

features.name: lerd db-import-host:connect
features.detail: Save how to reach this machine's own server: connect <mysql|postgres> [--host] [--port] [--user] [--password] [--socket] [--bin-dir]

features.name: lerd db-import-host:list
features.detail: The databases on this machine's own server and the lerd site each one fills

features.name: lerd db-import-host:import
features.detail: Copy a site's database from this machine's own server into lerd: import [site...] [--all] [--from <database>] [--database <name>]

features.name: Import database from this machine
features.detail: Replace this site's lerd database with the one of the same name on the MySQL or PostgreSQL server installed on this machine, after a snapshot

features.name: db-import-host_list
features.detail: List the databases on the MySQL/MariaDB or PostgreSQL server installed natively on this machine (outside lerd), with the lerd site each one would fill

features.name: db-import-host_import
features.detail: Replace a lerd site's database with the copy on the machine's own MySQL or PostgreSQL server. Snapshots the lerd database first as before-host-import

managed.name: remote-pull
managed.description: Pull a site's database and uploaded files from its server over SSH, with an optional sanitize step

features.name: lerd remote-pull:setup
features.detail: Save the site's server: setup --ssh user@host --path /remote/project [--files a,b] [--sanitize file.sql] [--database --db-user --db-password]

features.name: lerd remote-pull:pull
features.detail: Pull the database and files from the site's server: pull [site] [--db-only | --files-only]

features.name: Pull from server
features.detail: Replace this site's database with a fresh copy from its server, after a snapshot, and sync its uploaded files

features.name: remote-pull_pull
features.detail: Replace a lerd site's local database with a fresh dump from its production or staging server over SSH, after a before-remote-pull snapshot, then sync its configured upload folders. The server is set once by the user with lerd remote-pull:setup

managed.name: visual-diff
managed.description: Screenshot a site's pages and see what changed since the baseline, pixel by pixel

features.name: lerd visual-diff:routes
features.detail: Show or replace the routes to screenshot: routes [site] [/route ...]

features.name: lerd visual-diff:hide
features.detail: Show or replace, inside the project, the CSS selectors blanked before each shot for content that changes on every load: hide [selector ...]

features.name: lerd visual-diff:login
features.detail: Inside the project, log in before capturing pages behind a login: login --path /login --user u --password p [--user-field css] [--password-field css] | --off

features.name: lerd visual-diff:baseline
features.detail: Screenshot the routes that have no baseline yet: baseline [site] [--all to retake every one]

features.name: lerd visual-diff:check
features.detail: Screenshot every route again and report what changed since the baseline; exits 1 on a change

features.name: lerd visual-diff:approve
features.detail: Take the last check's screenshots as the new baseline: approve [site] [/route ...]

features.name: Visual check
features.detail: Screenshot this site's routes and compare them with the baseline

features.name: visual-diff_check
features.detail: Screenshot a lerd site's configured routes in Chromium and compare each with its baseline. Returns per-route status (same, changed, new), the changed pixel count and their share of the page

features.name: visual-diff_baseline
features.detail: Screenshot a lerd site's routes that have no baseline yet, for later checks to compare against. With all, retake every route's baseline, which throws the old ones away; ask the user first

features.name: visual-diff_approve
features.detail: Accept the last check's screenshots as the baseline, for the given routes or every changed one. Only after the user agreed the change is intended
